info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Rosemary Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the creation and management of rosemary syrup product details within the catalog. Retailers and manufacturers can utilize this endpoint to submit new product information, including descriptions, pricing, and availability. This ensures that consumers can access accurate and up-to-date details about rosemary syrup offerings. Ideal for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, this API streamlines the product listing process, enhancing overall operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information related to rosemary syrup, including various attributes and specifications necessary for effective documentation and processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the rosemary syrup. It should contain all necessary information related to the syrup's characteristics, production details, and any other relevant attributes expected by the server.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the relevant details are returned.
